conditional_blocker_before_solver_author.risk: The solver opens output with STATUS=REPLACE; an unsafe argv[3] could overwrite a protected baseline before post-run drift is detected. A mismatched data directory or loader environment could use different coefficients/libraries than the ones in the receipt.
conditional_blocker_before_solver_author.required_scope: Before any build/calls, a separately reviewed immutable launcher must validate fresh non-colliding output, exact datadir/policy/override/cwd/environment, actual resolved dynamic libraries (including LD_PRELOAD), and pre/post hashes. The proposal README correctly says the preflight is not a launcher, but its gate is not sufficient by itself.
